population_gate.classification_rule: At least 192 untouched confirmation clusters with complete future profile packets permits the preregistered confirmatory decision. A catalog overlap count at or above 192 is only a necessary population upper bound, not proof of profile completeness or trial readiness. Between 120 and 191 is underpowered exploratory; fewer than 120 does not open as the primary trial.
